name: WDUi Framework SDK
changes_cs: Aktualizovany WDUi Framework SDK: RichTextBlock cacheuje segment layout a link hit rects, stabilni rich text se uz nepremeruje pri kazdem paintu a self-test hlida richTextMeasureCount diagnostiku.
changes_en: Updated WDUi Framework SDK: RichTextBlock caches segment layout and link hit rects, stable rich text is no longer remeasured on every paint, and the self-test guards the richTextMeasureCount diagnostics.
